title: Ameris Bank Holds Grand Opening for New Savannah Branch
summary: Savannah, GA (May 7, 2026) Ameris Bank celebrated the grand opening of a new branch located at 120 Drayton Street in Savannah today. Serving customers in downtown Savannah, the new branch replaces the previous Ameris location at 24 Drayton Street and offers retail, business and commercial banking services, as well as mortgage lending services. The new downtown branch is in the 100-year-old Standard Oil Building and offers more than 8,700 square feet of space designed to honor the historic elements of the area. The branch features a drive-up ATM, drive-up night drop, two drive-through lanes, safety deposit boxes and a city-designated passenger loading only space for brief transactions. This new branch reflects our long-term commitment to Savannah and the people who make this community so special, said Lawton Bassett, Ameris Bank president.
